corpus.head: 57bd49f174811f6bbaf4e541019f9a7e9f34a98e
corpus.scope: HEAD ancestry; all commit messages, non-merge text diffs; bundled model trees excluded

method.ranking: cosine; commit ranked by best matching document
method.lexical: SQLite FTS5 OR term match after fixed stopwords; commit ranked by best matching document
method.hybrid: equal-weight reciprocal rank fusion, k=60, top 50 commits from semantic and lexical
method.precision: upstream ONNX f32/int8, official Qwen GGUF Q8_0, llama.cpp maintainers EmbeddingGemma GGUF Q8_0 including dense layers
method.corpus_chunking: commit messages plus non-merge textual diff chunks; model/cache paths excluded; approximately 850-character diff bodies
method.query_format: Model-specific prompts are recorded in each result. EmbeddingGemma also has an alternate code-retrieval query profile evaluated against the same document embeddings.

caveats: 12 retrospective questions from inspected commits in one 111-commit repository; not independent holdout or validated regression tasks.
Top-k counts measure retrieval of one known gold commit; other useful commits may be unlabeled.

Original ONNX runs cap at 512 tokens; Jina has a separate 1024-token rerun that preserves every document. Qwen and EmbeddingGemma consume full documents. One MiniLM/BGE document and eight original Jina documents were truncated; see metadata.
Warm query latency measures embedding only, not Git extraction, index lookup, ranking, CLI startup, or end-to-end search.
Document throughput is for this short corpus, not commits per second and not a 100k-commit scalability measurement.
Model size is the tested weight artifact only, not whole installation size or runtime RAM.
ONNX load time measures InferenceSession creation; llama.cpp load time measures fresh server readiness; OS file cache was not cleared.
ONNX peak memory is Python process RSS; Qwen reports server and driver RSS separately. Metal allocation accounting is not equivalent to CPU RSS.
Naive FTS/RRF baselines are not a competent Git-using agent baseline.

The MiniLM tokenizer initially reported fixed-padding/truncation token metadata; metadata was corrected with unbounded tokenization. Inference already used the intended 512-token dynamic padding configuration.
No Linux, Rust end-to-end, battery, sustained thermal, or large repository measurements were performed.
Separate Jina rerun was faster despite longer context. Machine load and thermal state were not controlled; do not infer a speedup from increasing the context cap.
EmbeddingGemma timings use its search-result query prefix; the alternate code-retrieval profile has quality metrics only.
EmbeddingGemma source is Google; tested converted artifact is published by llama.cpp maintainers, not Google directly.
Runtime device enumeration detected MTL0: Apple M2 and BLAS: Accelerate. Metal benchmarks requested all GPU layers; detailed per-operation device placement was not measured.
